source_title: First Trailer for Surgeon Thriller 'Transplant' with Eric Nam & Bill Camp
source_excerpt:
"All I ask: is that you be excellent at your work, and follow my instructions." Vertical has debuted the main official trailer for the film titled simply Transplant , an indie thriller about dueling surgeons. This initially premiered in 2024 at numerous regional festivals, including at the Chicago, Virginia, and Philadelphia Film Festivals. Ambitious surgical resident Jonah Yoon will do anything to become a top surgeon. But under Dr. Harmon, a brilliant heart transplant surgeon, Jonah is pushed to dangerous extremes when absolute loyalty is the price of success. Dr. Harmon is obsessed with protecting his perfect reputation. When his mother's health deteriorates, Jonah must choose between his duty as a son and the career his family sacrificed to help him achieve. Damn! Starring Bill Camp as Dr. Harmon, Eric Nam as Dr. Yoon, Michelle Okkyung Lee , April Grace , and Adam Arkin . Wow this looks intense! And I dig a good hospital thriller that's about the intricacies and politics of the doctor world since we don't often get a peek into this world much. Take a look.
Here's the new official trailer (+ poster) for Jason Park's film Transplant , direct from YouTube :
Jonah Yoon (Eric Nam) is a driven surgical resident determined to become a top surgeon, but his ambition pushes him to dangerous extremes. Under the tutelage of renowned heart transplant surgeon Dr. Edward Harmon (Bill Camp), Jonah learns that success comes at a price: absolute loyalty and subservience. When his mother's (Michelle Okkyung Lee) health deteriorates, Jonah must choose between his duty as a son and the career his family sacrificed to help him achieve. Transplant is directed by newcomer filmmaker Jason Park , making his feature directorial debut after other short films previously. The screenplay is written by David J. Lee & Jason Park. Produced by Ivan Kraljevic & Michael J. Urann. This initially premiered at the 2024 Chicago Film Festival a few years back plus other regional fests. Vertical debuts Park's Transplant film in select US theaters + on VOD starting November 20th, 2026 coming up this fall. Who wants to watch?
